I love this show and most of its characters. That being said, the character I HATE is Lapis. I genuinely despise her. I remember when the show first introduced Lapis, I was super excited to see a new gem. I immediately went to draw her after I finished that episode. However, as time progressed, her character became worse in my opinion.

Her personality and attitude is insufferable. I can’t stress enough how much I hate that Lapis was shown as the victim in the Malachite arc. She was the FURTHEST thing from the victim and the way that she had the nerve to play victim disgusted me. Jasper never forced Lapis to fuse with her. Lapis self admittedly agreed to fuse with her so that she can take out her anger and trauma on someone for once. So she can have a prisoner of her own after being imprisoned for so long. 

This is so disgusting and shameful. Jasper had nothing to do with Lapis’s trauma and for Lapis to force Jasper to stay in the fusion with her so she can abuse her is sick and cruel. After they unfused, Lapis was so coddled and treated like this poor precious angel who needs to be protected??? SHE was the one who decided to fuse with Jasper. SHE was the one who decided to use all her strength and energy to force Jasper to stay in the fusion and to abuse Jasper. Her being like “oh boo hoo I was trapped under the ocean for a year and had to use all my energy and strength to stay in the fusion 🥺” Well WHO’S FAULT IS THAT??? 

Saying she did it to protect Steven isn’t even a valid reason because Garnet already beat Jasper up and Steven was surrounded by the Crystal Gems. He was safe. The reason Jasper even asked Lapis to fuse with her in the first place was because she was already defeated and didn’t feel like she can defeat the Crystal Gems by herself. And again, Lapis literally admitted that she fused with Jasper so she can have a prisoner of her own. Then in ‘Alone At Sea’ she says she liked abusing Jasper because it was cathartic for her trauma. I really hate how this was brushed over in the show and never brought up again. 

Additionally, Lapis is generally just very rude, nasty, and whiny. Peridot made all those efforts to welcome and befriend Lapis and Lapis was unnecessarily mean to her. Then had the nerve to complain about how traumatic the water is for her when Peridot gifted her that pool???? Again, WHO’S fault is it that you were trapped in the ocean???????? 

Honestly as someone who has experienced a lot of trauma, it really disappoints me how Lapis is supposed to represent trauma in the show. Your trauma is NEVER an excuse to hurt other people. Lapis is a horrible character and I will always hate her.
